notes.title: Digital Artbook now available!
notes.notes:
The Digital Artbook for The Elevator Game with Catgirls is now available on Steam! Be quick and grab it while it's still on discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344340/The_Elevator_Game_with_Catgirls__Digital_Artbook/

Coincidentally, tomorrow (Friday 13th) marks the second anniversary of EGC's release. It's been a hard two years - both personally and creatively - for us, but we're slowly getting back on track with our gamedev plans and shenanigans. We hope you stick around. As always - we're happy and thankful for your overall support!

- Nayru, KleeBentz, and Xolf

notes.title: VISUAL NOVEL FEST + MYSTERY GAMEDEV ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
The Elevator Game with Catgirls is taking part in the Visual Novel Fest!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/79h8ugE.png[/img]

But that's not all!

Today we have a MAJOR announcement!

During the past two months we've been working with other mystery game developers to form a community where we can learn and grow together.

We call this community Mystery Gamedev!

[url=https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA][img]https://i.imgur.com/uSwScwv.png[/img][/url]

We're just getting started, but we already have 15+ developers of popular mystery games, with hundreds of positive reviews and thousands of players each.

We'd like to invite everyone who enjoys mystery games -- fans, developers, and content creators -- to join!

Mystery games span many genres, and include highly popular games such as Ace Attorney, Danganronpa, Zero Escape, and many more!

If you'd like to discover new and upcoming mystery games from indie devs, or learn how to create your own, then come and join our Discord server!

Join the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA]https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA[/url]

Learn More: [url=https://mysterygamedev.com]https://mysterygamedev.com[/url]

notes.title: Release Date - December 13th!
notes.notes:
Mark your calendars, guys! :)

We'll do our absolute best to release the game with its voice acting included. If for any reason we're unable to hit the deadline, we'll release on the promised date anyway, and then patch the voices in as soon as we're able.

We're aware that the timescale is quite tight, but we're pretty confident now about the release date - we know what's left to do, we know we can do it, and we definitely want you to be able to enjoy our tale before Christmas. :)
